263	// GenerateSnippet creates a plain text summary from markdown content.
264	func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error) {
265		root, err := s.parse(content)
266		if err != nil {
267			return "", err
268		}
269	
270		var buf strings.Builder
271		var lastNodeWasBlock bool
272	
273		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
274			if entering {
275				// Skip code blocks entirely (but keep inline code spans for snippet text)
276				switch n.Kind() {
277				case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock:
278					return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
279				default:
280					// Continue walking for other node types
281				}
282	
283				// Add space before block elements (except first)
284				switch n.Kind() {
285				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
286					if buf.Len() > 0 && lastNodeWasBlock {
287						buf.WriteByte(' ')
288					}
289				default:
290					// No space needed for other node types
291				}
292			}
293	
294			if !entering {
295				// Mark that we just exited a block element
296				switch n.Kind() {
297				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
298					lastNodeWasBlock = true
299				default:
300					// Not a block element
301				}
302				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
303			}
304	
305			lastNodeWasBlock = false
306	
307			// Extract text from various node types
308			switch node := n.(type) {
309			case *gast.Text:
310				segment := node.Segment
311				buf.Write(segment.Value(content))
312				if node.SoftLineBreak() {
313					buf.WriteByte(' ')
314				}
315			case *gast.AutoLink:
316				buf.Write(node.URL(content))
317				return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
318			case *mast.TagNode:
319				buf.WriteByte('#')
320				buf.Write(node.Tag)
321			default:
322				// Ignore other node types.
323			}
324	
325			// Stop walking if we've exceeded double the max length
326			// (we'll truncate precisely later)
327			if buf.Len() > maxLength*2 {
328				return gast.WalkStop, nil
329			}
330	
331			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
332		})
333	
334		if err != nil {
335			return "", err
336		}
337	
338		snippet := buf.String()
339	
340		// Truncate at word boundary if needed
341		if len(snippet) > maxLength {
342			snippet = truncateAtWord(snippet, maxLength)
343		}
344	
345		return strings.TrimSpace(snippet), nil
346	}

456	func uniquePreserveCase(strs []string) []string {
457		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
458		var result []string
459	
460		for _, s := range strs {
461			if _, exists := seen[s]; !exists {
462				seen[s] = struct{}{}
463				result = append(result, s)
464			}
465		}

470	// truncateAtWord truncates a string at the last word boundary before maxLength.
471	// maxLength is treated as a rune (character) count to properly handle UTF-8 multi-byte characters.
472	func truncateAtWord(s string, maxLength int) string {
473		// Convert to runes to properly handle multi-byte UTF-8 characters
474		runes := []rune(s)
475		if len(runes) <= maxLength {
476			return s
477		}
478	
479		// Truncate to max length (by character count, not byte count)
480		truncated := string(runes[:maxLength])
481	
482		// Find last space to avoid cutting in the middle of a word
483		lastSpace := strings.LastIndexAny(truncated, " \t\n\r")
484		if lastSpace > 0 {
485			truncated = truncated[:lastSpace]
486		}
487	
488		return truncated + " ..."

85	func (s *APIV1Service) listUsersByIDWithExisting(ctx context.Context, userIDs []int32, existing map[int32]*store.User) (map[int32]*store.User, error) {
86		usersByID := make(map[int32]*store.User, len(existing)+len(userIDs))
87		for userID, user := range existing {
88			if user != nil {
89				usersByID[userID] = user
90			}
91		}
92	
93		missingUserIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(userIDs))
94		seenMissingUserIDs := make(map[int32]struct{}, len(userIDs))
95		for _, userID := range userIDs {
96			if _, ok := usersByID[userID]; ok {
97				continue
98			}
99			if _, ok := seenMissingUserIDs[userID]; ok {
100				continue
101			}
102			seenMissingUserIDs[userID] = struct{}{}
103			missingUserIDs = append(missingUserIDs, userID)
104		}
105	
106		if len(missingUserIDs) == 0 {
107			return usersByID, nil
108		}
109	
110		missingUsersByID, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, missingUserIDs)
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, err
113		}
114		for userID, user := range missingUsersByID {
115			if user != nil {
116				usersByID[userID] = user
117			}
118		}
119		return usersByID, nil

171	// batchConvertMemoRelations batch-loads relations for a list of memos and returns
172	// a map from memo ID to its converted relations. This avoids N+1 queries when listing memos.
173	func (s *APIV1Service) batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx context.Context, memos []*store.Memo, includeSnippets bool) (map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation, error) {
174		if len(memos) == 0 {
175			return map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation{}, nil
176		}
177	
178		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get user")
181		}
182		var memoFilter string
183		if currentUser == nil {
184			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
185		} else {
186			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
187		}
188	
189		memoIDs := make([]int32, len(memos))
190		memoIDSet := make(map[int32]bool, len(memos))
191		for i, m := range memos {
192			memoIDs[i] = m.ID
193			memoIDSet[m.ID] = true
194		}
195	
196		outgoingRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
197			SourceMemoIDList: memoIDs,
198			MemoFilter:       &memoFilter,
199		})
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch list outgoing memo relations")
202		}
203		incomingRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
204			RelatedMemoIDList: memoIDs,
205			MemoFilter:        &memoFilter,
206		})
207		if err != nil {
208			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch list incoming memo relations")
209		}
210		allRelations := mergeMemoRelations(outgoingRelations, incomingRelations)
211	
212		// Collect all memo IDs referenced in relations that we need to resolve.
213		neededIDs := make(map[int32]bool)
214		for _, r := range allRelations {
215			neededIDs[r.MemoID] = true
216			neededIDs[r.RelatedMemoID] = true
217		}
218	
219		// Build ID→UID map from the memos we already have.
220		memoIDToUID := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
221		memoIDToSnippet := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
222		for _, m := range memos {
223			memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
224			if includeSnippets {
225				snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
226				if err != nil {
227					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo content snippet")
228				}
229				memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
230			}
231			delete(neededIDs, m.ID)
232		}
233	
234		// Batch fetch any additional memos referenced by relations that we don't already have.
235		if len(neededIDs) > 0 {
236			extraIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(neededIDs))
237			for id := range neededIDs {
238				extraIDs = append(extraIDs, id)
239			}
240			extraFind := &store.FindMemo{IDList: extraIDs, ExcludeContent: !includeSnippets}
241			extraMemos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, extraFind)
242			if err != nil {
243				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch fetch related memos")
244			}
245			for _, m := range extraMemos {
246				memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
247				if includeSnippets {
248					snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
249					if err != nil {
250						return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get related memo content snippet")
251					}
252					memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
253				}
254			}
255		}
256	
257		// Build the result map: memo ID → its relations (both directions).
258		result := make(map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation, len(memos))
259		for _, r := range allRelations {
260			memoUID, ok1 := memoIDToUID[r.MemoID]
261			relatedUID, ok2 := memoIDToUID[r.RelatedMemoID]
262			if !ok1 || !ok2 {
263				continue
264			}
265	
266			relation := &v1pb.MemoRelation{
267				Memo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
268					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memoUID),
269					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.MemoID],
270				},
271				RelatedMemo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
272					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, relatedUID),
273					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.RelatedMemoID],
274				},
275				Type: convertMemoRelationTypeFromStore(r.Type),
276			}
277	
278			// Add to the memo that owns this relation (both directions).
279			if memoIDSet[r.MemoID] {
280				result[r.MemoID] = append(result[r.MemoID], relation)
281			}
282			if memoIDSet[r.RelatedMemoID] {
283				result[r.RelatedMemoID] = append(result[r.RelatedMemoID], relation)
284			}
285		}
286	
287		return result, nil
288	}

299	func mergeMemoRelations(groups ...[]*store.MemoRelation) []*store.MemoRelation {
300		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
301		merged := make([]*store.MemoRelation, 0)
302		for _, relations := range groups {
303			for _, relation := range relations {
304				key := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", relation.MemoID, relation.RelatedMemoID, relation.Type)
305				if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
306					continue
307				}
308				seen[key] = struct{}{}
309				merged = append(merged, relation)
310			}
311		}
312		return merged
313	}

26	// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.
27	func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
28		// Process memos in batches to avoid loading all memos into memory at once
29		const batchSize = 100
30		offset := 0
31		processed := 0
32	
33		for {
34			limit := batchSize
35			memos, err := r.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
36				Limit:  &limit,
37				Offset: &offset,
38			})
39			if err != nil {
40				slog.Error("failed to list memos", "err", err)
41				return
42			}
43	
44			// Break if no more memos
45			if len(memos) == 0 {
46				break
47			}
48	
49			// Process batch
50			batchSuccessCount := 0
51			for _, memo := range memos {
52				if err := RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, r.MarkdownService); err != nil {
53					slog.Error("failed to rebuild memo payload", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
54					continue
55				}
56				if err := r.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, &store.UpdateMemo{
57					ID:      memo.ID,
58					Payload: memo.Payload,
59				}); err != nil {
60					slog.Error("failed to update memo", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
61					continue
62				}
63				batchSuccessCount++
64			}
65	
66			processed += len(memos)
67			slog.Info("Processed memo batch", "batchSize", len(memos), "successCount", batchSuccessCount, "totalProcessed", processed)
68	
69			// Move to next batch
70			offset += len(memos)
71		}
72	}

115	// parse is an internal helper to parse content into AST.
116	func (s *service) parse(content []byte) (gast.Node, error) {
117		reader := text.NewReader(content)

122	func isTagNodeInLinkOrImage(n gast.Node) bool {
123		for parent := n.Parent(); parent != nil; parent = parent.Parent() {
124			switch parent.Kind() {
125			case gast.KindLink, gast.KindImage:
126				return true
127			default:
128				// Keep walking ancestors.
129			}
130		}
131		return false
132	}
133	
134	func asMemoTagNode(n gast.Node) (*mast.TagNode, bool) {
135		tagNode, ok := n.(*mast.TagNode)
136		if !ok || isTagNodeInLinkOrImage(n) {
137			return nil, false
138		}
139		return tagNode, true
140	}

142	// ExtractTags returns all #tags found in content.
143	func (s *service) ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error) {
144		root, err := s.parse(content)
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, err
147		}
148	
149		var tags []string
150	
151		// Walk the AST to find tag nodes
152		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
153			if !entering {
154				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
155			}
156	
157			if tagNode, ok := asMemoTagNode(n); ok {
158				tags = append(tags, string(tagNode.Tag))
159			}
160	
161			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
162		})
163	
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, err
166		}
167	
168		// Deduplicate tags while preserving original case
169		return uniquePreserveCase(tags), nil
170	}

172	// extractHeadingText extracts plain text content from a heading node.
173	func extractHeadingText(n gast.Node, source []byte) string {
174		var buf strings.Builder
175		for child := n.FirstChild(); child != nil; child = child.NextSibling() {
176			extractTextFromNode(child, source, &buf)
177		}
178		return buf.String()
179	}
180	
181	// extractTextFromNode recursively extracts plain text from a node and its children.
182	func extractTextFromNode(n gast.Node, source []byte, buf *strings.Builder) {
183		if textNode, ok := n.(*gast.Text); ok {
184			buf.Write(textNode.Segment.Value(source))
185			return
186		}
187		for child := n.FirstChild(); child != nil; child = child.NextSibling() {
188			extractTextFromNode(child, source, buf)
189		}
190	}

192	// ExtractProperties computes boolean properties about the content.
193	func (s *service) ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error) {
194		root, err := s.parse(content)
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198	
199		prop := &storepb.MemoPayload_Property{}
200		firstBlockChecked := false
201	
202		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
203			if !entering {
204				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
205			}
206	
207			// Check if the first block-level child of the document is an H1 heading.
208			if !firstBlockChecked && n.Parent() != nil && n.Parent().Kind() == gast.KindDocument {
209				firstBlockChecked = true
210				if heading, ok := n.(*gast.Heading); ok && heading.Level == 1 {
211					prop.Title = extractHeadingText(n, content)
212				}
213			}
214	
215			switch n.Kind() {
216			case gast.KindLink:
217				prop.HasLink = true
218	
219			case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
220				prop.HasCode = true
221	
222			case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
223				prop.HasTaskList = true
224				if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
225					if !checkBox.IsChecked {
226						prop.HasIncompleteTasks = true
227					}
228				}
229			default:
230				// No special handling for other node types
231			}
232	
233			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
234		})
235	
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239	
240		return prop, nil
241	}

263	// GenerateSnippet creates a plain text summary from markdown content.
264	func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error) {
265		root, err := s.parse(content)
266		if err != nil {
267			return "", err
268		}
269	
270		var buf strings.Builder
271		var lastNodeWasBlock bool
272	
273		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
274			if entering {
275				// Skip code blocks entirely (but keep inline code spans for snippet text)
276				switch n.Kind() {
277				case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock:
278					return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
279				default:
280					// Continue walking for other node types
281				}
282	
283				// Add space before block elements (except first)
284				switch n.Kind() {
285				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
286					if buf.Len() > 0 && lastNodeWasBlock {
287						buf.WriteByte(' ')
288					}
289				default:
290					// No space needed for other node types
291				}
292			}
293	
294			if !entering {
295				// Mark that we just exited a block element
296				switch n.Kind() {
297				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
298					lastNodeWasBlock = true
299				default:
300					// Not a block element
301				}
302				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
303			}
304	
305			lastNodeWasBlock = false
306	
307			// Extract text from various node types
308			switch node := n.(type) {
309			case *gast.Text:
310				segment := node.Segment
311				buf.Write(segment.Value(content))
312				if node.SoftLineBreak() {
313					buf.WriteByte(' ')
314				}
315			case *gast.AutoLink:
316				buf.Write(node.URL(content))
317				return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
318			case *mast.TagNode:
319				buf.WriteByte('#')
320				buf.Write(node.Tag)
321			default:
322				// Ignore other node types.
323			}
324	
325			// Stop walking if we've exceeded double the max length
326			// (we'll truncate precisely later)
327			if buf.Len() > maxLength*2 {
328				return gast.WalkStop, nil
329			}
330	
331			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
332		})
333	
334		if err != nil {
335			return "", err
336		}
337	
338		snippet := buf.String()
339	
340		// Truncate at word boundary if needed
341		if len(snippet) > maxLength {
342			snippet = truncateAtWord(snippet, maxLength)
343		}
344	
345		return strings.TrimSpace(snippet), nil
346	}

355	// ExtractAll extracts tags, properties, and references in a single parse for efficiency.
356	func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error) {
357		root, err := s.parse(content)
358		if err != nil {
359			return nil, err
360		}
361	
362		data := &ExtractedData{
363			Tags:     []string{},
364			Mentions: []string{},
365			Property: &storepb.MemoPayload_Property{},
366		}
367	
368		firstBlockChecked := false
369	
370		// Single walk to collect all data
371		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
372			if !entering {
373				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
374			}
375	
376			if tagNode, ok := asMemoTagNode(n); ok {
377				data.Tags = append(data.Tags, string(tagNode.Tag))
378			}
379			if mentionNode, ok := n.(*mast.MentionNode); ok {
380				data.Mentions = append(data.Mentions, strings.ToLower(string(mentionNode.Username)))
381			}
382	
383			// Check if the first block-level child of the document is an H1 heading.
384			if !firstBlockChecked && n.Parent() != nil && n.Parent().Kind() == gast.KindDocument {
385				firstBlockChecked = true
386				if heading, ok := n.(*gast.Heading); ok && heading.Level == 1 {
387					data.Property.Title = extractHeadingText(n, content)
388				}
389			}
390	
391			// Extract properties based on node kind
392			switch n.Kind() {
393			case gast.KindLink:
394				data.Property.HasLink = true
395	
396			case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
397				data.Property.HasCode = true
398	
399			case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
400				data.Property.HasTaskList = true
401				if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
402					if !checkBox.IsChecked {
403						data.Property.HasIncompleteTasks = true
404					}
405				}
406			default:
407				// No special handling for other node types
408			}
409	
410			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
411		})
412	
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416	
417		// Deduplicate tags while preserving original case
418		data.Tags = uniquePreserveCase(data.Tags)
419		data.Mentions = uniquePreserveCase(data.Mentions)
420	
421		return data, nil
422	}

424	// RenameTag renames all occurrences of oldTag to newTag in content.
425	func (s *service) RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error) {
426		root, err := s.parse(content)
427		if err != nil {
428			return "", err
429		}
430	
431		// Walk the AST to find and rename tag nodes
432		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
433			if !entering {
434				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
435			}
436	
437			if tagNode, ok := asMemoTagNode(n); ok {
438				if string(tagNode.Tag) == oldTag {
439					tagNode.Tag = []byte(newTag)
440				}
441			}
442	
443			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
444		})
445	
446		if err != nil {
447			return "", err
448		}
449	
450		// Render back to markdown using the already-parsed AST
451		mdRenderer := renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()
452		return mdRenderer.Render(root, content), nil
453	}

455	// uniquePreserveCase returns unique strings from input while preserving case.
456	func uniquePreserveCase(strs []string) []string {
457		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
458		var result []string
459	
460		for _, s := range strs {
461			if _, exists := seen[s]; !exists {
462				seen[s] = struct{}{}
463				result = append(result, s)
464			}
465		}
466	
467		return result
468	}

470	// truncateAtWord truncates a string at the last word boundary before maxLength.
471	// maxLength is treated as a rune (character) count to properly handle UTF-8 multi-byte characters.
472	func truncateAtWord(s string, maxLength int) string {
473		// Convert to runes to properly handle multi-byte UTF-8 characters
474		runes := []rune(s)
475		if len(runes) <= maxLength {
476			return s
477		}
478	
479		// Truncate to max length (by character count, not byte count)
480		truncated := string(runes[:maxLength])
481	
482		// Find last space to avoid cutting in the middle of a word
483		lastSpace := strings.LastIndexAny(truncated, " \t\n\r")
484		if lastSpace > 0 {
485			truncated = truncated[:lastSpace]
486		}
487

85	func (s *APIV1Service) listUsersByIDWithExisting(ctx context.Context, userIDs []int32, existing map[int32]*store.User) (map[int32]*store.User, error) {
86		usersByID := make(map[int32]*store.User, len(existing)+len(userIDs))
87		for userID, user := range existing {
88			if user != nil {
89				usersByID[userID] = user
90			}
91		}
92	
93		missingUserIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(userIDs))
94		seenMissingUserIDs := make(map[int32]struct{}, len(userIDs))
95		for _, userID := range userIDs {
96			if _, ok := usersByID[userID]; ok {
97				continue
98			}
99			if _, ok := seenMissingUserIDs[userID]; ok {
100				continue
101			}
102			seenMissingUserIDs[userID] = struct{}{}
103			missingUserIDs = append(missingUserIDs, userID)
104		}
105	
106		if len(missingUserIDs) == 0 {
107			return usersByID, nil
108		}
109	
110		missingUsersByID, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, missingUserIDs)
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, err
113		}
114		for userID, user := range missingUsersByID {
115			if user != nil {
116				usersByID[userID] = user
117			}
118		}
119		return usersByID, nil
120	}

209		}
210		allRelations := mergeMemoRelations(outgoingRelations, incomingRelations)
211	
212		// Collect all memo IDs referenced in relations that we need to resolve.
213		neededIDs := make(map[int32]bool)
214		for _, r := range allRelations {
215			neededIDs[r.MemoID] = true
216			neededIDs[r.RelatedMemoID] = true
217		}
218	
219		// Build ID→UID map from the memos we already have.
220		memoIDToUID := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
221		memoIDToSnippet := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
222		for _, m := range memos {
223			memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
224			if includeSnippets {
225				snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
226				if err != nil {
227					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo content snippet")
228				}
229				memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
230			}
231			delete(neededIDs, m.ID)
232		}
233	
234		// Batch fetch any additional memos referenced by relations that we don't already have.
235		if len(neededIDs) > 0 {
236			extraIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(neededIDs))
237			for id := range neededIDs {
238				extraIDs = append(extraIDs, id)
239			}
240			extraFind := &store.FindMemo{IDList: extraIDs, ExcludeContent: !includeSnippets}
241			extraMemos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, extraFind)
242			if err != nil {
243				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch fetch related memos")
244			}
245			for _, m := range extraMemos {
246				memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
247				if includeSnippets {
248					snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
249					if err != nil {
250						return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get related memo content snippet")
251					}
252					memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
253				}
254			}
255		}
256	
257		// Build the result map: memo ID → its relations (both directions).
258		result := make(map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation, len(memos))
259		for _, r := range allRelations {
260			memoUID, ok1 := memoIDToUID[r.MemoID]
261			relatedUID, ok2 := memoIDToUID[r.RelatedMemoID]
262			if !ok1 || !ok2 {
263				continue
264			}
265	
266			relation := &v1pb.MemoRelation{
267				Memo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
268					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memoUID),
269					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.MemoID],
270				},
271				RelatedMemo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
272					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, relatedUID),
273					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.RelatedMemoID],
274				},
275				Type: convertMemoRelationTypeFromStore(r.Type),
276			}
277	
278			// Add to the memo that owns this relation (both directions).
279			if memoIDSet[r.MemoID] {
280				result[r.MemoID] = append(result[r.MemoID], relation)
281			}
282			if memoIDSet[r.RelatedMemoID] {
283				result[r.RelatedMemoID] = append(result[r.RelatedMemoID], relation)
284			}
285		}
286	
287		return result, nil
288	}

26	// RunOnce rebuilds the payload of all memos.
27	func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context) {
28		// Process memos in batches to avoid loading all memos into memory at once
29		const batchSize = 100
30		offset := 0
31		processed := 0
32	
33		for {
34			limit := batchSize
35			memos, err := r.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
36				Limit:  &limit,
37				Offset: &offset,
38			})
39			if err != nil {
40				slog.Error("failed to list memos", "err", err)
41				return
42			}
43	
44			// Break if no more memos
45			if len(memos) == 0 {
46				break
47			}
48	
49			// Process batch
50			batchSuccessCount := 0
51			for _, memo := range memos {
52				if err := RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, r.MarkdownService); err != nil {
53					slog.Error("failed to rebuild memo payload", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
54					continue
55				}
56				if err := r.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, &store.UpdateMemo{
57					ID:      memo.ID,
58					Payload: memo.Payload,
59				}); err != nil {
60					slog.Error("failed to update memo", "err", err, "memoID", memo.ID)
61					continue
62				}
63				batchSuccessCount++
64			}
65	
66			processed += len(memos)
67			slog.Info("Processed memo batch", "batchSize", len(memos), "successCount", batchSuccessCount, "totalProcessed", processed)
68	
69			// Move to next batch
70			offset += len(memos)
71		}
72	}

122	func isTagNodeInLinkOrImage(n gast.Node) bool {
123		for parent := n.Parent(); parent != nil; parent = parent.Parent() {
124			switch parent.Kind() {
125			case gast.KindLink, gast.KindImage:
126				return true
127			default:
128				// Keep walking ancestors.
129			}
130		}
131		return false
132	}

134	func asMemoTagNode(n gast.Node) (*mast.TagNode, bool) {
135		tagNode, ok := n.(*mast.TagNode)
136		if !ok || isTagNodeInLinkOrImage(n) {
137			return nil, false
138		}
139		return tagNode, true
140	}

142	// ExtractTags returns all #tags found in content.
143	func (s *service) ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error) {
144		root, err := s.parse(content)
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, err
147		}
148	
149		var tags []string
150	
151		// Walk the AST to find tag nodes
152		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
153			if !entering {
154				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
155			}
156	
157			if tagNode, ok := asMemoTagNode(n); ok {
158				tags = append(tags, string(tagNode.Tag))
159			}
160	
161			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
162		})
163	
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, err
166		}
167	
168		// Deduplicate tags while preserving original case
169		return uniquePreserveCase(tags), nil
170	}

172	// extractHeadingText extracts plain text content from a heading node.
173	func extractHeadingText(n gast.Node, source []byte) string {
174		var buf strings.Builder
175		for child := n.FirstChild(); child != nil; child = child.NextSibling() {
176			extractTextFromNode(child, source, &buf)
177		}
178		return buf.String()
179	}

181	// extractTextFromNode recursively extracts plain text from a node and its children.
182	func extractTextFromNode(n gast.Node, source []byte, buf *strings.Builder) {
183		if textNode, ok := n.(*gast.Text); ok {
184			buf.Write(textNode.Segment.Value(source))
185			return
186		}
187		for child := n.FirstChild(); child != nil; child = child.NextSibling() {
188			extractTextFromNode(child, source, buf)
189		}
190	}

192	// ExtractProperties computes boolean properties about the content.
193	func (s *service) ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error) {
194		root, err := s.parse(content)
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198	
199		prop := &storepb.MemoPayload_Property{}
200		firstBlockChecked := false
201	
202		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
203			if !entering {
204				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
205			}
206	
207			// Check if the first block-level child of the document is an H1 heading.
208			if !firstBlockChecked && n.Parent() != nil && n.Parent().Kind() == gast.KindDocument {
209				firstBlockChecked = true
210				if heading, ok := n.(*gast.Heading); ok && heading.Level == 1 {
211					prop.Title = extractHeadingText(n, content)
212				}
213			}
214	
215			switch n.Kind() {
216			case gast.KindLink:
217				prop.HasLink = true
218	
219			case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
220				prop.HasCode = true
221	
222			case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
223				prop.HasTaskList = true
224				if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
225					if !checkBox.IsChecked {
226						prop.HasIncompleteTasks = true
227					}
228				}
229			default:
230				// No special handling for other node types
231			}
232	
233			return gast.WalkContinue, nil
234		})
235	
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239	
240		return prop, nil
241	}

263	// GenerateSnippet creates a plain text summary from markdown content.
264	func (s *service) GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error) {
265		root, err := s.parse(content)
266		if err != nil {
267			return "", err
268		}
269	
270		var buf strings.Builder
271		var lastNodeWasBlock bool
272	
273		err = gast.Walk(root, func(n gast.Node, entering bool) (gast.WalkStatus, error) {
274			if entering {
275				// Skip code blocks entirely (but keep inline code spans for snippet text)
276				switch n.Kind() {
277				case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock:
278					return gast.WalkSkipChildren, nil
279				default:
280					// Continue walking for other node types
281				}
282	
283				// Add space before block elements (except first)
284				switch n.Kind() {
285				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
286					if buf.Len() > 0 && lastNodeWasBlock {
287						buf.WriteByte(' ')
288					}
289				default:
290					// No space needed for other node types
291				}
292			}
293	
294			if !entering {
295				// Mark that we just exited a block element
296				switch n.Kind() {
297				case gast.KindParagraph, gast.KindHeading, gast.KindListItem, east.KindTableCell, east.KindTableRow, east.KindTableHeader:
298					lastNodeWasBlock = true
299				default:
300					// Not a block element
301				}
302				return gast.WalkContinue, nil
303			}
304	
305			lastNodeWasBlock = false
306	
307			// Extract text from various node types
308			switch node := n.(type) {
